 Sport Nguyen Quang Vinh and the return of Song Lam Nghe An to the National Team
 Duc Anh • November 5, 2026 11:33 After nearly three years absent from the national team, Song Lam Nghe An has had a player recalled as midfielder Nguyen Quang Vinh is included in coach Kim Sang-sik's squad.
 The return again belong to River Blue Turmeric An 
 Song Lam Nghe An is considered one of the most traditional clubs in Vietnamese football. Not only has it contributed many talented players, but the team from Nghe An has also had key figures in the national team. From previous generations to Que Ngoc Hai, Phan Van Duc, and Pham Xuan Manh, players who have grown up at SLNA have always left a lasting impression.
 SLNA is in very good form this season. Photo: SLNA However, in recent years, the presence of SLNA players in the Vietnamese national team has become increasingly rare. In particular, since Que Ngoc Hai and Pham Xuan Manh left the team in 2023, SLNA has been almost completely absent from national team training camps. This is a situation that worries many fans in Nghe An province, as a team that once contributed many national team players to Vietnamese football is no longer able to maintain that status.
 The reasons stem partly from financial difficulties over several seasons. Lacking the resources to retain their best players, SLNA has repeatedly had to part ways with key players after their contracts expired. This not only affected their performance in the V.League but also left the team without players capable of competing for a place in the national team.
 Entering the 2026/27 season, SLNA began to show positive changes. The arrival of a new sponsor and personnel adjustments helped the team stabilize its squad. In particular, under the guidance of coach Van Sy Son, SLNA is developing a playing style that suits its current players.
 Despite not possessing many star players, the Nghe An team has shown a fierce fighting spirit, tight defensive organization, and effective transitions between phases of play. After 6 rounds, SLNA remains undefeated with 12 points, ranking second in the V.League 2026/27 standings. This is a start that has exceeded the expectations of many fans.
 Quang Vinh's impressive performance earned him a call-up to the Vietnamese national team. Photo: SLNA This progress has given SLNA players more opportunities to showcase their abilities. And in the list of the Vietnamese national team preparing for the Casper Cup 2026 international friendly tournament during FIFA Days in November, coach Kim Sang-sik decided to give midfielder Nguyen Quang Vinh a chance.
 After nearly three years of waiting, the Nghe An team once again has a player currently on their roster called up to the national team. Although it's only the beginning, this event is still very encouraging for SLNA.
 Sign un belong to Glory 
 Nguyen Quang Vinh's call-up is not entirely unexpected, considering what the 2005-born midfielder has shown since the start of the season. After 6 rounds in the V.League 2026/27, Quang Vinh has scored 3 goals, although he has mostly started from the bench. He only started in the match against Hong Linh Ha Tinh, while in other matches coach Van Sy Son usually brought him on in the second half.
 Notably, Quang Vinh scored a brace in the 4-1 victory against Hanoi FC at Hang Day Stadium. His two late goals showcased the young midfielder's confidence, movement, and finishing ability. He then went on to score in the 2-2 draw against Hong Linh Ha Tinh with a skillful finish just outside the penalty area.
 Quang Vinh during a training session with the Vietnamese youth national team. (Photo: Archival image) Quang Vinh's strengths lie not only in his goal-scoring ability. Despite playing as a central midfielder, he consistently tends to push forward, actively penetrating the penalty area and seeking scoring opportunities. This characteristic provides coach Van Sy Son with additional options to create breakthroughs when a change in tactics is needed.
 In SLNA's current personnel management, Ho Khac Ngoc usually takes on the role of organizer and tempo controller. When this veteran midfielder needs to be replaced, Quang Vinh brings dynamism and better attacking support capabilities.
 Of course, the 21-year-old midfielder still has limitations that need improvement. Compared to Khac Ngoc, Quang Vinh lacks experience in controlling the tempo of the game. Sometimes he gets drawn into the opponent's style of play, resulting in inconsistent midfield organization. However, these are issues that can be improved when the young player gets more regular playing time and experience.
 Before being called up to the national team, Quang Vinh had already gained international experience by participating in the 2026 ASIAD in Japan with the Vietnam U23 team.
 At this tournament, Quang Vinh was given the opportunity to play in all four matches by coach Dinh Hong Vinh. Notably, in the quarter-final match against U23 South Korea, the SLNA midfielder was given his first starting place. Although U23 Vietnam lost 0-4, Quang Vinh still left his mark with a shot that hit the post of the opponent's goal.
 It can be said that the experiences at the ASIAD Games and his impressive goal-scoring form in the V.League have helped Quang Vinh mature step by step. However, being called up is only the initial opportunity. To be able to compete for a position in the Vietnamese national team, he needs to continue improving his ball control, playmaking abilities, and maintaining consistent performance.
 After several seasons of absence, Nguyen Quang Vinh's call-up to the Vietnamese national team is welcome news for Song Lam Nghe An. This could be the beginning of the Nghe An team gradually reclaiming its role in providing personnel for the national team, while also rekindling the pride of fans in the contributions of their hometown football.
